description: US federal campaign contributions (FEC Schedule A itemized receipts) from the official OpenFEC API, by contributor name, employer, committee ID or state for a two-year cycle: contributor, employer, occupation, city/state/ZIP, amount, date, committee, receipt type, memo and filing image link, newest first, with total count. FEC law forbids using contributor names for solicitation or commercial purposes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

contributor.description: Contributor name, e.g. Bezos (name searches can take ~20 s at FEC)

cycle.description: Two-year period ending year, e.g. 2024 (default: current cycle)

name: finance_fec_campaign_finance_contributions
title: Finance Fec Campaign Finance Contributions
